text:
Hannah Lee: Heads-up — Cerulean just returned our RFI and wants a compact capability matrix + POC quote. Main asks: customer-managed HSM, VPC peering, APAC data residency, and a one-page security summary. RFI uploaded: s3://redwood-sales/cerulean/cerulean-rfi-2026.pdf

Rajesh Nair: Proposed POC: 3 business days (day 0 prep + identity mapping, day 1 ingest + embeddings eval, day 2 perf + handoff). Will include a replay script to simulate ~120 concurrent sessions. Need to confirm expected embedding volume.

Olivia Park: I'll create the matrix. Columns: Feature | Hosted | Dedicated | Private | Notes. Rows: tenant isolation, per-tenant KMS, HSM import, VPC peering, regional data residency, retention & audit logs, compliance artifacts. I'll mark FedRAMP as roadmap and list compensating controls.

Hannah Lee: Budget ask from Cerulean: POC quote line items + whether we can provide a temporary Dedicated pool. They asked about pricing and SLA for Dedicated during POC.

Rajesh Nair: Pricing suggestion: $3.5k platform credits + $1k infra stipend if they need an on-prem evaluation kit. If they sign a Dedicated commit within 60 days, offer 30% discount on month 1 invoice. For temporary Dedicated during POC we can offer a time-boxed reserved pool — include in quote as optional line item.

Olivia Park: Security snippet for RFI Q: "Do you support customer-managed HSM?" -> "Yes. Private deployments support BYOK with PKCS#11-compatible HSMs; Hosted customers can request dedicated encryption controls under enterprise contract. We do not permit private-key export from customer HSMs. Audit logs and key rotation are supported." I'll paste final wording into the deliverables folder.

Marco (legal): NDA + DPA must be signed before ingestion. Recommend SOW for POC that caps retention to 30 days and details rollback & data deletion steps. Pen-test needs 10 business days notice and a scoped test plan. I'll upload SOW template.

DeployBot: Calendar: tentative POC kickoff scheduled 2026-07-14 09:00 AEST 1:00 UTC. Invite sent to cerulean-poc@cerulean.com.

Rajesh Nair: Tech note for matrix: Dedicated baseline SLO = 99.9% (TBD by model); autoscale policies available, and prefix/KV caching can lower token usage by ~15-25% for chat workloads. Also call out that Private supports VPC peering and direct network ingress options.

Olivia Park: Example embedding eval curl to include in deliverable:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["policy doc","kb snippet"]}'

Hannah Lee: I'll assemble the capability_matrix_cerulean_v1.xlsx, rfi_answers_cerulean.md, and the POC quote in s3://redwood-sales/cerulean/deliverables/ and aim to return the RFI today.

Marco (legal): Uploaded NDA + DPA templates and the SOW snippet. Ping me when deliverables are ready and I'll fast-track countersign.

Rajesh Nair: FYI if Cerulean requires APAC-only storage we should recommend Private deployment (VPC) or regional Dedicated pools. Hosted is available in APAC regions but tenancy isolation differs.

Olivia Park: Draft pushed to s3://redwood-sales/cerulean/deliverables/capability_matrix_cerulean_v1.xlsx and rfi_answers_cerulean_v1.md. Please review and lgtm so we can send.

Hannah Lee: Reviewing now. If no objections, I'll send the package and attach the proposed POC SOW. :thumbsup:
